Sezzle's standard pay-in-4 plan splits a purchase into four equal installments over six weeks: 25% at checkout, then 25% every two weeks. The schedule is fixed at order creation and shown in the app under the order detail.

The first installment is charged at the time of purchase. Remaining installments auto-charge to your default payment method on the due date (local time, morning batch). You can pay any installment early at no cost; early payment does not change later due dates.

Note: Some merchants offer pay-in-2 or monthly plans instead. The specific schedule for your order is determined by the merchant and confirmed in your order detail.
